comments.author: adudewithbadaim
comments.body_html:
this patch

0.16.2.0.35665 (17 March 2025)

Under ’ AI Changes and Improvements’

  • Bots can no longer see through vegetation unless an enemy is very close to them
  • Bot vision is reduced if they are inside the vegetation

0.16.1.3.35312 (28 February 2025)

  • Adjusted the AI visibility depending on vegetation. Removed the ability to see the enemy through gaps in vegetation at medium and long ranges for all bots, including Bosses, except for Zryachiy, Birdeye, and the BTR. Now, bots will no longer see through gaps in trees and bushes, but if there is a space between separate vegetation, the bot will still be able to see the enemy. This system will be further improved in future patches to make it even more predictable

having said that, idk if this mod covers anything else that hasnt been patched by BSG, or maybe this method is better than what BSG has done?

comments.author: somtam
comments.body_html:
Interesting. Let me disable the mod and test it more.

The mod is pretty heavy handed, so if enemy is shooting at you and you walk into a bush they are forced to stop aiming and shooting you. Something that the patch above won’t do.

If you are in a bush and you shoot enemy, they are unable to target and shoot at you. So the mod is a bit cheesy.

comments.body_html:
addresses 1 of the top 2 hated things about AI in Tark.
Being bush esp : ON and Headshot: ON.
These functions are part of how BSG so often makes the game harder in certain parts of the wipe. They leave these Bot cheatcodes : ON.
Or turn them off and we noticed the AI gets “easier” suddenly.
HATE being headshot by unseen bots? These mods are for you.

These two settings were clickable in Donuts. But thats not updated to current SPT and/or FIKA, so we need this.
